nodes.label: Hero as Thesis principle
nodes.rationale: Open with the most characteristic thing in the subject's world (headline, image, animation, demo) as a deliberate choice rather than a generic big-number-plus-gradient template.

nodes.label: Typography Carries Personality principle
nodes.rationale: Pair display and body faces deliberately per-project rather than reusing the same families every time, so type itself becomes a memorable part of the design.

nodes.label: Structure Is Information principle
nodes.rationale: Structural devices (numbering, eyebrows, dividers) should encode something true about the content, not decorate it - e.g. numbered markers only when content is truly sequential.

nodes.label: Writing in Design guidance
nodes.rationale: Copy is design material: write from the end user's side of the screen, use active voice, keep vocabulary consistent through a flow, and treat errors/empty states as moments for direction not mood.

nodes.label: graphify Trigger Rule (.claude/CLAUDE.md)
nodes.rationale: When the user types /graphify, use the installed graphify skill or instructions before doing anything else.

nodes.label: Node ID format rule ({stem}_{entity})
nodes.rationale: IDs must use the full repo-relative path (every directory level) joined with entity name, matching the AST extractor's convention exactly, so semantic and structural extraction never create orphan ghost-duplicate nodes for same-named files in different directories.

nodes.label: Discrete confidence rubric (0.95/0.85/0.75/0.65/0.55)
nodes.rationale: Models follow discrete rubrics better than continuous ranges; production showed a bimodal collapse to 0.5 and 0.85+, so a fixed discrete scale is enforced instead of a free-form 0-1 score.

nodes.label: Hyperedges rule (max 3 per chunk)
nodes.rationale: Used only when 3+ nodes share a concept/flow/pattern not captured by pairwise edges alone, to avoid noisy over-grouping.

nodes.label: semantically_similar_to edge rule
nodes.rationale: Added only when two concepts solve the same problem without any structural link (no import/call/citation), to surface non-obvious cross-cutting similarity.

nodes.label: Constrained query expansion (Step 0)
nodes.rationale: The query CLI matches via case-folded substring + IDF with no stemming/synonyms/cross-language matching, so the question must be expanded against the graph's own label vocabulary first or the literal matcher returns 0 hits and collapses to noise.

nodes.label: save-result feedback loop / work memory
nodes.rationale: Saves the question/answer/outcome (useful/dead_end/corrected) back into the graph so future --update runs extract it as a node, closing a self-improving loop.

nodes.label: Domain-hint Whisper prompt (GRAPHIFY_WHISPER_PROMPT)
nodes.rationale: The host agent writes a one-sentence domain hint itself from god-node labels and passes it as Whisper's initial prompt, avoiding a separate API call.

nodes.label: build_merge() function
nodes.rationale: Reads graph.json directly without a NetworkX round-trip so edge direction (calls/implements/imports) is always preserved, and replace-on-re-extract drops stale nodes for changed source files before merging.

nodes.label: "This is NOT the Next.js you know" rule
nodes.rationale: This project's Next.js version has breaking changes vs. training data; agents must read node_modules/next/dist/docs and heed deprecation notices before writing code.
nodes.norm_label: "this is not the next.js you know" rule

nodes.label: Project graphify Integration Rules (root CLAUDE.md)
nodes.rationale: Codebase questions should run graphify query/path/explain first when graphify-out/graph.json exists, since these return a scoped subgraph much smaller than GRAPH_REPORT.md or raw grep; run graphify update . after code changes.

nodes.label: RTL Persian localization requirement
nodes.rationale: User required the site be right-to-left with all copy in Persian except the brand name "Adagio", driving a full RTL/Vazirmatn-font rework across Home, Product, and Login.

nodes.label: Hero header redesign from reference image
nodes.rationale: User supplied a reference image; hero was rebuilt as a giant tracked wordmark (Anton font) behind a vignette-masked product shot, dusk glow, abstract mountain silhouette, and grain overlay, with the slogan revealed as a second scroll beat.
